subscriberId.description:
The PEXA internal reference for the subscriber initiating the API service call.
Maximum 19 characters

role.description:
Valid values are dependent on the subscriber type.
If the subscriber is acting in multiple roles within the workspace, only one role must be provided.
Only the following roles can be provided to maintain settlement date and time within the workspace:
  • Incoming Mortgagee
  • Mortgagee on Title
  • Incoming Proprietor
  • Proprietor on Title
  • Incoming Caveator

settlementActionType.description:
Valid values are
  • Accept (Accept the Settlement Date/Time which has been proposed)
  • Reset to pending (Reset prior acceptance of settlement date and time to the status of Pending. )
  • Propose new date and time(Propose a new Settlement date and time with a reason of change set)

settlementDateAndTime.description:
The settlement date/time is provided (in UTC) to ensure the participant settlement acceptance status is being set against the settlement date/time which is currently in the workspace.
If the settlement date/time provided here differs to that of the workspace, an error will be returned advising that the settlement details are misaligned.
Must be provided when the Settlement Action Type is 'Accepted' or 'Reset to pending'. Must not be provided when the Settlement Action Type is Propose new date and time.

settlementDetails.description:
The settlement date and time details to set/propose in the workspace.
Must be provided if the Settlement Action Type is Propose new date and time.
Must not be provided if Settlement Action Type is Reset to pending or Accepted.

settlementDateAndTime.description: The proposed date and time for settlement (in UTC)

participantSettlementAcceptanceStatus.description:
Ability to specify if the Settlement Date and Time should be considered accepted or pending when proposing a new date and time.
If no participant settlement acceptance status is provided, the subscribers default acceptance status will be used. Valid values are
  • Accepted (Set the Participants Settlement Acceptance Status to the Accepted status.)
  • Pending (Set the Participants Settlement Acceptance Status to the Pending status. )

reason.description:
The reason for updating the settlement date/time in the workspace.
Maximum 100 characters
